judgeCalibration.scopeBoundary: The existing calibration supports the generic evaluation protocol. Activation additionally requires deterministic hard checks and stable long-form results; the long-form semantic dimensions are not treated as human-calibrated in isolation.

sampleProtocol.stopRule: Run all preregistered repetitions unless a credential, provider, or protocol failure makes the packet unverifiable; do not add or remove runs after observing quality results.

candidates.description: Current production plan-then-write behavior: outline plus the existing continuation_state carrying outline, section index, and the last 4000 characters of written body.

Current behavior plus one admitted task-contract rule requiring each section to advance its own outline item, preserve established terms and conclusions, avoid restating completed sections, and leave the requested conclusion explicit. Budgets are unchanged.

Evaluation-only versioned state snapshot containing plan progress, outline-derived terminology conventions, completed-section summaries, unresolved outline items, recent body tail, generation attempt, body version, and empty evidence allocations. It is not production implementation.

aggregation.dimensionPassRate: passed must-pass dimension results divided by 15 candidate-run dimension results
aggregation.fullyPassingRun: all five must-pass dimensions pass and deterministic completion checks pass
aggregation.resourceMetric: arithmetic mean across the three completed generation runs
aggregation.firstCharacterLatency: wall time from candidate start until the first completed section becomes available, matching the current non-streaming per-section production path
aggregation.pairwise: For each generation repetition, compare minimal_prompt_adjustment with long_form_state_prototype in both display orders. The repetition counts as a LongFormState win only when both orders select the same canonical LongFormState body; tie or disagreement is not a win.

decisionRule.activated: Only if the same must-pass defect is stable in current_final_writing, minimal_prompt_adjustment does not reach the release line, long_form_state_prototype reaches the release line, gains at least the preregistered pass-rate margin, wins the preregistered blind comparisons, has no dimension regression, and stays within every resource limit.
decisionRule.notActivated: Use not_activated when current or minimal reaches the release line, the LongFormState benefit is unstable or below threshold, any required evidence is unavailable, or any resource/non-regression limit is missed.

identityRequirements: provider, model, thinking and Prompt Envelope version
requested, resolved, applied and provider usage budgets
qualified and admitted evidence identities, including an explicit empty set
estimated cost, first-character latency and complete latency
